title: Chanel goes sheer and wild for Matthieu Blazy’s spring/summer 2027 show
snippet: Matthieu Blazy continued to loosen up Chanel’s house codes for spring/summer 2027, sending sheer skirts, tiger-print tweed and flashes of animal print down a spectacular Grand Palais runway.

title: Commentary: Can commuters’ fatigue from North-South Corridor construction be better managed?
snippet: A liveable city must remain liveable while it is being built, say Samuel Chng and Sarah Chan of Singapore University of Technology and Design.

title: What Prabowo’s biggest Cabinet reshuffle to date signals as he nears 2 years in office
snippet: President Prabowo Subianto’s seventh Cabinet reshuffle mixes political loyalists with technocrats in some of Indonesia’s most consequential portfolios, as analysts see him consolidating authority ahead of his second anniversary in office.

title: 'They think it's just a picnic spot': Kusu Island regulars lament its declining appeal among youth

title: Commentary: When someone makes you feel unsafe in public, do you confront, film or walk away?
snippet: Think you’re being followed or watched by a stranger? Trust the warning signal but do not turn yourself into the investigator, says lawyer Gloria James.

title: Commentary: Why a booming economy is not helping Trump
snippet: Anxiety about AI and affordability has turned US President Donald Trump's populist party into a popular target, says Ruchir Sharma for the Financial Times.
